_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for MCP <-> agent-skill parity. The ProductClank agent REST API (/api/v1/agents/*) is canonical; the agent skill and this MCP server are BOTH wrappers over it. Every endpoint the skill documents MUST appear here with an `mcp` status. `scripts/check-skill-parity.mjs` fails CI when the skill references an endpoint that is missing here. Paths are normalized: no origin, no /api/v1 prefix, path params written as {id}.

statuses.live: Exposed as an MCP tool today.
statuses.planned: Intended as an MCP tool; not built yet (see `tier`).

endpoints.note: List a token-free product (LIST_WITHOUT_TOKEN). URL-first: server auto-fills name/tagline/description/logo/X via extractFromUrl; explicit fields override; socials optional. Idempotent per owner. Free.

Two tools over one endpoint: suggest_content_campaign (dry_run:true, free preview) + create_content_campaign (dry_run:false, launch, 1000cr). Content = Growth Boost / take_action; submissions + judging stay in the webapp (v1).
Free. Per-user agent key → the endpoint reports the connected user's own balance (direct-Supabase workaround removed in v0.8.0).
Content Studio: content-enabled spaces the caller may draft into (owner / account-delegate / campaign-member). Free.

Content Studio: draft up to 25 ContentDraft candidates (source='agent') into a space, written in the brand voice. FREE; auto-reviewed (score-only) in the background; never auto-published — a human stages in the webapp. platform must be a workspace platform. Distinct from campaigns/content (community content campaign).
Content Studio: the brand's calibration — voice, platforms, post types, playbook, threshold, topic inventory, style guides. Free. enabled:false when no workspace.

Content Studio onboarding: turn content on (space_id or new_space:{name} → solo AmplifySpace) with voice/platforms/post_types/topics as fields (free) or a pasted brand_doc (5cr). Also updates settings later.
Content Studio: topic inventory list. Free.
Content Studio: add ≤12 topics (keywords proposed when omitted). Free.
Content Studio: edit / pause a topic. Free.
Content Studio: remove a topic. Free.
Content Studio: KB-grounded topic ideas (action 'suggest'). Free.
Content Studio: the space's drafts with reviewer score/verdict/summary. Free.

Content Studio: stage / discard / edit (free); revise (presets: shorter, longer, punchier, deeper, simpler, more_specific, less_salesy, more_casual, more_formal) / fix / humanize / review (2cr). Never publishes.
Content Studio learning loop: a reaction → durable KB rule (1cr), applied immediately by default (apply:false leaves it pending in web Settings).

Discovery campaign, 10cr. Campaigns are stamped creator_id = the connected user (per-user agent); every read/op below is scoped to the acting user's own agent key. `visibility` param: REST default public (network distribution, network replies bill the owner); the MCP tool defaults PRIVATE (owner's workbench only) and requires explicit user intent for public. `platform` twitter|linkedin|reddit|youtube (default twitter) picks the discovery pipeline; `target_subreddits` / `target_youtube_channels` narrow it (rejected with 400 on a mismatched platform rather than silently ignored). tiktok is NOT offered — screenshot-only proof, which agents cannot supply.
Free. Returns ALL the user's campaigns — web-created included (creator_id scope since v0.8.1/app widening), not just connector-created.
Free. Config + posts/replies stats.
12cr/post discovered; Apify discovery + Claude reply drafting, can take minutes.
FREE topic/competitor analysis, 7-day cache; the sanctioned pre-flight before generate_posts.
2cr/post reviewed — dry_run billed too (the AI review runs either way). The daily-spend cap sees the real pending charge.
5cr/reply with edit_request; claimed replies refused. The daily-spend cap sees the real pending charge.
Free. Grants a webapp user My-Campaigns access to an agent-created campaign.

Free. Visibility private→public REQUIRES confirm:true (400 confirmation_required otherwise) since v0.8.1. Keywords MERGE (add/remove, min 1 max 40). `sources` → enabled_verticals (keywords always forced in) is the only /v1 way to APPLY research phrases/influencers/lists. monitor_accounts → research_analysis.selectedInfluencerUsernames (auto-enables influencers). relevance_threshold 1-10, is_active pause/resume, visibility flip ALSO cascades CommuniplyPost.is_public — the earn feed requires both, so a campaign-only flip would be cosmetic. Also `platform` (409 platform_locked once ANY post exists — switching would mix two platforms' posts and proof rules in one funnel) and `target_subreddits` / `target_youtube_channels` (replace-semantics, [] clears; validated against the platform the campaign will have AFTER the request, so switch+retarget in one call works).

Free, no scraping. Since-watermark delta: new posts (semantic_relevance_score — the score the gate decides on), replies claimed since with live reply_url + survival/engagement, `quiet` flag, and `checked_at` to pass back as `since`.

Free and scrape-free BY DESIGN — the webapp analytics route spends Apify credits, so an agent polling that would drain the user. Funnel + approval rate over judged replies only + survival gated by SURVIVAL_VOLUME_FLOOR + spend from CreditTransactions.campaign_id + credits_per_usable_reply.

Read side of the schedule (current config, projection, balance, cap, limits, blockers). The MCP tool covers reads via its un-confirmed call, which changes nothing and returns the same projection; get_campaign also carries the current schedule state.

Standing discovery. Free to call, but AUTHORIZES UNATTENDED SPEND — the hourly cron bills the OWNER 12cr per post found with no human in the loop. `enabled:true` without `confirm:true` → 400 confirmation_required + cost projection (the v0.5.2 communication contract enforced at the API layer, so the REST/skill path gets it too). CRITICAL: scheduled runs bill creator_id directly and NEVER pass through validateCallerUserId, so the per-user daily spend cap cannot brake them per-run — it is enforced HERE as a ceiling (429 daily_spend_cap_exceeded). Agent limits 4 runs/day, 20 posts/run, 600cr/day projected (workbench allows 24×100), because the cron clears only ~2-4 campaigns per 300s invocation.
Free. Returns the connected user's transactions (per-user agent key).

Free. Globally unclaimed reply drafts (a claimed draft drops out for everyone). REPLY-ONLY by design at BOTH layers: like/repost need an uploaded screenshot and there is no agent upload path, so the backend serves only AGENT_COMPLETABLE_ACTION_TYPES and 400s on ?actionType=like|repost. An empty feed is normal, not an error.

Reply claims on X / Reddit / YouTube / LinkedIn. Attribution runs off the EARNING user's linked handle for that platform (ensure*Handle, same helpers as the web path) — unlinked → 'add your handle'. X additionally gets a synchronous author-match against the live post. Likes/reposts + TikTok need an uploaded screenshot → action_type_unavailable.
Free. Scoped to the acting user via their per-user agent key.
Free. Active public take-action/content campaigns + community campaigns from the acting user's spaces; kind = content | take_action.
Free. Full brief + judging criteria + rewards + the user's remaining submission allowance.

Free — EARNS on approval (community→Stars, public→points). Lands PENDING in CampaignSubmissions. cast_url and/or media_url and/or description; media_url = hosted image/video for ad-hoc creative tasks (LINKS ONLY, no uploads) — direct-image/X URLs go to image_url and render inline in the owner review modal, everything else stays a link. Guards: URL validity, campaign-wide duplicate proof, X-post author-match vs the acting user's linked handle, per-agent daily cap.
Free. Status + review notes; point allocations hidden until rewards ship (web parity).
Tier 3. $PRO pays the AGENT's wallet and is gated on erc8004_agent_id + allowlist; there is no path to pay a human user's wallet yet.
Tier 3. Pairs with claim-signature (agent-wallet-only $PRO claim).
